label: вул. Суворова, 1-А (Будинок Суворова)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 1a House where lived and worked O.Suvorov 01 (YDS 3636).jpg (2016-07-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 1a House where lived and worked O.Suvorov (YDS 3634).jpg (2016-07-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (351) вул. Суворова, 1а.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Штаб-квартира Суворова Херсон.jpg (2016-08-27, CC BY-SA 4.0, Dniprovych)
notes: 2-storey 18th-c. house, two edges (edge 2 is left/east, edge 1 right/west as seen from the street). Raised granite-clad plinth, white window surrounds, mint-green wall, projecting 3-bay central pavilion with an iron balcony and a pediment-like parapet straddling the edge 2/edge 1 vertex (balcony bays listed as indexes 0-1 of edge 1). Ground floor: roller-shutter opening and two blind arched niches in the pavilion. Bay counts +-1.

label: вул. Суворова, 3 (клуб «Трудові резерви»)
sources: File:2017 Херсон (360) вул. Суворова, 3.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Суворова 3 Херсон.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, Крістіна Федорович)
File:Вул. Суворова, 3.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
File:Херсон, вул. Суворова, 3.jpg (2020-08-12, CC BY-SA 4.0, Константинъ)
notes: 1-storey club in grey painted pebble-dash with a dark-grey porch: gable-fronted canopy (steel frame, teal polycarbonate roof) over two double brown wooden doors with fanlights, 4-step grey stair, large coat-of-arms mosaic in the gable. Flanking wings have 1-2 white-framed windows each side. The porch is shallower than the 28.8 m edge so the pattern is symmetric by estimation.

label: вул. Суворова, 5 (ТЦ «Суворова 5»)
sources: File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 5 Dwelling House (YDS 3656).jpg (2016-07-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (369) вул. Суворова, 5.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Суворова 5 Херсон.jpg (2016-08-27, CC BY-SA 4.0, Dniprovych)
File:Суворова, 5.jpg (2016-06-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, E vasiukov)
notes: 2-storey 19th-c. house, cream/yellow stucco, white-cream trim, dark red granite plinth (1.0-1.3 m), banded rustication on ground floor, arched door in a big arch moulding at the east (left) end plus a second arched door at the right end, string course, dentil cornice. Brown wooden windows (segmental heads). One iron balcony on the upper floor slightly right of centre. A tree hides one ground bay. Pattern bay count +-1.

label: вул. Суворова, 6 (будинок Марченка)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 6 Dwelling House of Marchenko 01 (YDS 4287).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 6 Dwelling House of Marchenko 01 (YDS 4290).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (362) вул. Суворова, 6.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Вул. Суворова, 6.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
notes: Single-storey (with very tall 1.6 m basement/plinth in dark pebble-and-shell conglomerate) neo-Gothic/Moorish house: grey-blue render with salmon-pink pointed-arch window surrounds, pilaster strips and heavy salmon frieze; small corner lantern/cupola; hip roof of dark corrugated sheet. Front door with iron canopy and pointed pediment. Which of edges 9/10 is the fully street-facing wall could not be resolved (edge 9 is closest); bay count +-1.

label: вул. Суворова, 8 (будинок Куликовського)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 8 Dwelling House of Kulikovskiy 01 (YDS 4292).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (373) вул. Суворова, 8.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Вул. Суворова, 8.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 8 Dwelling House of Kulikovskiy 01 Details (YDS 4295).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
notes: 2-storey late-19th-c. house in salmon-pink rough plaster with white window surrounds (ground floor with pediment hoods, aediculae), two caryatids (atlantes) flanking a carriage passage at the left, wrought-iron balcony above the passage, rusticated base band, attic block with round window above the passage; yellow ramps and a canopied door at the right end. The leftmost bays are cut off by scaffolding in the photos so left bays are assumed. Bay count +-1.

label: вул. Суворова, 9 (кутовий будинок з еркером)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 9 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 4178).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 9 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 3662).jpg (2016-07-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 9 Dwelling House 02 (YDS 3659).jpg (2016-07-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Житловий будинок Суворова 9.jpg (2016-08-27, CC BY-SA 4.0, Dniprovych)
notes: 3-storey Art Nouveau/Neoclassical corner house (cafe Mirasol at ground). Salmon/terracotta render, beige-grey stone-like corner tower with a glazed 2-storey bay window (erker), round decorative medallion on the upper left, iron balconies, later glazed loggias at the left. Ground floor is a modern cafe/shop front with a terrace. Pattern covers only the part visible in the photos; 41.3 m edge approximated with 13 bays.

label: вул. Суворова, 17 (з брамою 17–19)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 17-19 Gates (YDS 4225).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (384) вул. Суворова, 17019, брама з двору.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Брама , вул. Суворова, 17–19.jpg (2020-09-27, CC BY-SA 4.0, Dasha 5556)
notes: Two adjacent 2-storey houses at the 17/19 gate share a brick-lined arched carriage passage. In the photo the right house has a yellow/pink upper floor with a balcony over the arch (sign «Суворова, 17»), the left one a turquoise shop front and three white-framed upper windows. Assignment of left/right to OSM 17/19 is uncertain; the gate is placed in this row. Dates 2016-2020.

label: вул. Суворова, 19 (Будинок Беновича)
sources: File:Вул. Суворова, 19.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 17-19 Gates (YDS 4225).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
notes: Photos only show a cream-rendered ground floor with a large shop window and the plaque «Дом Беновича», and a turquoise shop front with three upper windows (probably this house, left of the gate). Rest assumed. Upper wall guessed from the pink/orange upper floor in the 17-19 photo.

label: вул. Суворова, 22 (будинок купця)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 22 House of Merchant 01 (YDS 4297).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (387) вул. Суворова, 22.jpg (2017-05-01, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 22 House of Merchant 02 (YDS 4298).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Вул. Суворова, 22.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
notes: 2-storey merchant house: salmon plaster over brick, stone-coloured window surrounds with small hoods, decorative frieze/cornice with relief rosettes, small iron balcony at the left end, brown wooden-frame windows. Ground floor was gutted into a bank (Таскомбанк) with a wide grey/white shop front and a surviving tall wooden door at the left (plaque «22»). The photos show about 6 upper bays over about 18 m but the OSM edge near the street is only 13 m, so OSM 20/22 may be split differently; pattern has 5 bays for 13 m.

label: вул. Суворова, 23 (за фото Commons «21»: кутовий будинок з магазином «Тавр'я»)
sources: File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 21 Dwelling House (YDS 4218).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (98) вул. Суворова, 21.jpg (2017-04-28, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 21 Dwelling House 02 (YDS 4216).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Суворова, 21.jpg (2016-06-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, E vasiukov)
notes: No OSM building has housenumber 21 on Suvorova; Commons «21 Yevropeiska Street» photos show a 2-storey grey late-Art-Nouveau house on the corner of a cross street (ground floor ochre-yellow shops, upper floors grey cement render with vertical pilaster strips, meander frieze, stepped parapet and a central tower-like gable at the roof). I attached them to OSM 23 whose 31.5 m edge sits closest to the street axis at a corner. Pattern is a rough guess of the window rhythm.

label: вул. Суворова, 24 (триповерховий будинок з балюстрадами)
sources: File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 24 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 4332).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 24 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 4334).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:65-101-0167 Херсон.jpg (2017-04-28, CC BY-SA 4.0, Крістіна Федорович)
File:2017 Херсон (88) вул. Суворова, 24.jpg (2017-04-28, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
notes: 3 storeys (OSM says 2): shops at ground, stone balustrade running along the first-floor level, iron balconies, upper walls beige with quoins around windows and wreaths/medallions in relief, small cornice, an arched-lunette pediment on the roof of the left part. Ground floor pink-peach render with banded rustication (modern shop signs «Робін-Бобін»). 30.9 m edge assumed to be the long street side; bay counts approximate.

label: вул. Суворова, 25 (магазин «Дніпро Стиль»)
sources: File:Вул. Суворова, 25.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 25 Dwelling House (YDS 4215).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (91) вул. Суворова, 25.jpg (2017-04-28, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
notes: Single-storey 1990s-2000s shop: mint-green render with a navy plinth band, two large shop windows and a glazed double door in the middle. Roof: green-blue corrugated sheet in 2016-17 photos but brown metal-tile gable by 2019 (later wins). The 32.9 m edge also includes a side wall and rear.

label: вул. Суворова, 28 (кутовий будинок)
sources: File:Вул. Суворова, 28.jpg (2019-09-14, CC BY-SA 4.0, Helen Owl)
File:Kherson-2017 Suvorova Str. 28 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 4209).jpg (2016-07-17, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:Kherson Suvorova Str. 28 Dwelling House 01 (YDS 4339).jpg (2016-07-18, CC BY-SA 4.0, Nataliya Shestakova)
File:2017 Херсон (57) вул. Суворова, 28.jpg (2017-04-28, CC BY-SA 4.0, ЯдвигаВереск)
notes: 2-storey eclectic corner house with rusticated corner pilasters, bracketed cornice with big brackets, pediment-hooded windows (stucco in poor repair), ground floor yellow (corner) / cream with shop fronts (Лото-маркет, Доярушка) and one iron balcony in the middle. The 34.7 m edge exceeds the part photographed; pattern largely extrapolated.
